hypotheses.name: Weak structured residual around global latent dynamics
hypotheses.scientific_question: Can a constrained residual capture repeatable deviations left by the global operator?
hypotheses.mechanism: Shared global operator plus low-complexity state-conditioned residual.
hypotheses.motivation: The global linear baseline is much stronger than the fully regime-conditioned model.
hypotheses.explanation_of_previous_failure: Independent local operators may have too much variance.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: A constrained residual should improve validation without materially hurting one-step accuracy.
hypotheses.relation_to_existing_methods: Related to residual operator learning; novelty requires verification.

hypotheses.name: Higher-order latent memory
hypotheses.scientific_question: Is the current latent state insufficient to summarize recent history?
hypotheses.motivation: Good one-step global accuracy with accumulating rollout error leaves memory as a competing explanation.
hypotheses.explanation_of_previous_failure: A first-order Markov latent model may be missing temporal information.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: Adding one lag should reduce multi-step error if memory matters.
minimum_experiment: evaluate one-step and rollout on development_validation
hypotheses.relation_to_existing_methods: Related to autoregressive ROMs; novelty requires verification.

hypotheses.name: Low-dimensional nonlinear lifting
hypotheses.scientific_question: Does a compact nonlinear feature space linearize the latent evolution better?
hypotheses.mechanism: Feature lifting followed by linear dynamics.
hypotheses.motivation: The global linear law may capture the dominant component while leaving structured nonlinear residuals.
hypotheses.explanation_of_previous_failure: Hard regime switching is only one possible nonlinear mechanism.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: A compact lift should improve rollout at modest complexity.
hypotheses.relation_to_existing_methods: Related to Koopman/lifting methods; novelty requires verification.
